title: Onboard several servers to Azure Arc over PowerShell remoting
summary: Use Connect-AzConnectedMachine with a PSSession to install the Connected Machine agent and register a batch of Windows servers in one run.
code:
Install-Module Az.ConnectedMachine -Scope CurrentUser
Connect-AzAccount
Set-AzContext -Subscription "<subscription-id>"

# One server (add -Proxy http://proxy.corp.example:8080 behind a proxy)
Connect-AzConnectedMachine -ResourceGroupName rg-arc-prod-weu -Name SRV01 -Location westeurope

# Several servers through remoting; resource names default to each host name
$s = New-PSSession -ComputerName SRV01,SRV02,SRV03
Connect-AzConnectedMachine -ResourceGroupName rg-arc-prod-weu -Location westeurope -PSSession $s
notes: Remoting needs Enable-PSRemoting on each target and an operator who is local admin there.
For hundreds of servers, a pushed script with a dedicated onboarding service principal scales better.
